verdict.rationale: Smooth ships an official, documented CLI. It has a dedicated docs section with an overview, integration guides for Claude Code, OpenClaw and other agents, and feature pages covering localhost tunneling, data extraction, authentication, files and live view. The GitHub repo also describes it as the Smooth CLI for AI agents, and a probe confirms the CLI docs exist. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of CLI usage (community comments discuss the product generally, not the CLI specifically).
